Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anil Kumar Choudhary
------

For the Petitioners : Ms. Prachi Pradipti, Advocate
 For the State : Mr. Sunil Kr. Dubey, Addl.P.P.

For the OP 2 : Mr. Anurag Kashyap, Advocate  ------
 Order No:-07 Dated:-04-12-2025  I.A. No.15794 of 2025  Heard the parties.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that this interlocutory application has been filed with a prayer to stay the further proceedings of Birsanagar P.S. Case No.89 of 2023 corresponding to G.R.
Case No.238 of 2024 pending in the Court of learned Judicial Magistrate-1st Class, Jamshedpur.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that this Cr.M.P. has been filed for quashing the FIR as well as the entire criminal proceeding including the order dated 16.02.2024 passed by the learned Judicial Magistrate-1st Class, Jamshedpur whereby and whereunder the learned Judicial Magistrate-1st Class, Jamshedpur has taken cognizance of the offences punishable under Sections 406, 420, 120B and 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
It is next submitted that the allegations do not prima facie constitute any offence rather it is a civil dispute.

It is next submitted that the trial court is about to embark on framing charge and the next date fixed is 06.12.2025 for framing of charge and if charge is framed, the trial will commence and irreparable loss will be caused to the petitioners.
Therefore, it is submitted that the prayer as prayed for in this Cr.M.P., be allowed.

Learned Addl.P.P. appearing for the State and the learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 on the other hand vehemently oppose the prayer of the petitioners and submits that there is ample material Rajrani Topno & Another vs The State Of Jharkhand & Another ... ...

sentences.text:
on 4 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/174218113/
1 in the record for framing charges against the petitioners and the staying of the trial court proceeding will further delay the prosecution of the case as much delay has already occurred because of non-cooperative attitude of the petitioners.
It is next submitted that the charge has not yet been framed, though, the FIR was lodged on 29.08.2023 and the charge sheet has also been submitted on 23.01.2024.

Keeping in view the fact that a delay of over 1 years and 10 months has already occurred in framing of charge and though, the cognizance of the offence was taken on 16.02.2024 and summoning order was passed against the petitioners on the same day and the petitioners having filed this Cr.M.P.
before this Court on 04.10.2023 were well aware about the proceedings, but still they took time for over a year till 06.05.2025 to appear in the trial Court and thus keeping in view the conduct of the petitioners in delaying the proceeding before the trial Court and to give an opportunity to trial court to take a call on the contention of the petitioners that the offence alleged against the petitioners is not made out, this Court is not inclined to stay the further proceedings of Birsanagar P.S. Case No.89 of 2023 corresponding to G.R. Case No.238 of 2024 pending in the Court of learned Judicial Magistrate-1st Class, Jamshedpur.
Accordingly, this interlocutory application being without any merit is dismissed.
(Anil Kumar Choudhary, J.) Heard the parties.
Learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 prays for time.
Prayer for time is allowed as the last chance.
List this case after eight weeks.

(Anil Kumar Choudhary, J.) 04/12/2025 Abhiraj/
